response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with ~18 years of software development experience, genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators), and some mobile exposure. However, this is a Level II people-management role, and the resume shows no formal people-management or organizational-leadership experience — a hard minimum requirement. His founder and workshop-instructor experience suggests mentorship ability but does not substitute for the required 2+ years managing engineers or 3+ years leading organizational change.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and testing-infrastructure experience (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium courses, CI/CD and GitLab setup)
Extensive polyglot engineering background (18+ years) exceeding the 8-year development minimum
Strong quality-engineering mindset (TDD, pairing, trunk-based development) with teaching and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or performance-management experience (minimum requires 2+ years)
No demonstrated experience setting team roadmaps or leading organizational change at scale
Mobile-platform experience is limited and dated (iOS/Apple TV work ended in 2016)

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tooling and test infrastructure background
IC-only career trajectory with no org-level leadership
